overview.subtitle: Solutions for electrical systems from design and engineering to operations and maintenance
paragraphs: ETAP provides market-leading software and hardware solutions serving all stages of the electrical system lifecycle for utilities, infrastructure, industries, and buildings. Through its integrated Electrical Digital Twin platform, ETAP delivers best-in-class, seamless customer experience and cloud-ready technology.
ETAP solutions enable universal accessibility for designers, engineers, and operators to accelerate their digital energy transformation — even in the highest regulated environments.
checklist: Unified electrical digital twin across the full system lifecycle
Design, analyze, operate, and automate from a single platform
Cloud-ready collaboration for distributed engineering teams
Trusted by utilities and enterprises worldwide since 1986
overview.highlightDescription: Full lifecycle, modular energy management with a unified electrical digital twin for modern power system design, analysis, operations, and automation — empowering teams to increase productivity, collaboration, and efficiency throughout their energy transition journey.

solutions.subtitle: Comprehensive capabilities across the entire electrical system lifecycle

items.title: Power System Analysis
items.description: Load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash safety, dynamics & transients, and distribution network analysis for reliable system design.

items.title: Energy Management
items.description: Power System Monitoring & Simulation (PSMS), real-time energy monitoring, efficiency optimization, and continuous energy intelligence for smarter operations.

items.title: Digital Twin
items.description: Integrated electrical digital twin with intelligent single-line diagrams, system modeling & visualization, and seamless data exchange across the asset lifecycle.

items.title: Grid Modernization
items.description: Distribution automation, model-based Volt/Var optimization (VVO), grid code compliance, and AI-driven tools transforming reactive grids into predictive intelligence.

items.title: Renewable Integration
items.description: Renewables & energy storage modeling, grid interconnection studies, and sustainable energy transition planning for evolving power portfolios.

items.title: Operational Intelligence
items.description: ETAP eSCADA, real-time infrastructure, smart operations dashboards, and predictive analytics for faster, data-driven decision making.
